description: Make topbar + sidebar + content responsive and usable on mobile.
steps: Define breakpoints for sidebar behaviour (overlay on mobile, persistent on desktop).
Ensure content spacing works at 360px width.
Test key pages on a mobile viewport.

description: Add a sleek collapse/expand button with fast→slow easing; collapsed shows icons only.
steps: Implement collapsed sidebar width and icon-only layout.
Persist collapsed state per-user (localStorage ok for now).

description: Tooltips + aria-labels when collapsed; keyboard navigation works.
steps: Add tooltips to icon buttons when collapsed.
Ensure aria-labels present for each nav item.

description: Use existing icon button stub and display unread badge count.
steps: Wire notification count state (API stub initially).
Add click handler to open notifications panel.

description: List notifications; mark read; show empty state.
steps: Add mark-read endpoint (or stub) + optimistic update.

description: Add logout action under user avatar; clear token + workspace selection.
steps: Clear auth token and workspace_id storage.

description: Style beyond background/text: cards, borders, inputs, sidebar, active states.
steps: Audit MUI theme tokens (palette, background, divider, action states).
Tune component overrides (Paper, AppBar, Drawer, Button, TextField).
Verify contrast + focus states in dark mode.

description: Add light/dark/system; system follows OS preference; persist per-user.
steps: Persist user preference (localStorage then backend later).

feature: UX: Breadcrumb component for multi-step flows
description: Reusable breadcrumb for flows; supports click-back; shows current step.
steps: Add to multi-step pages (submission flow first).

description: Page header + breadcrumbs + step content layout.
steps: Apply to submission flow and mapping UI.

description: Admin can create users in workspace with email+password; send invite/reset email via MailHog.
steps: Generate temporary password or reset token.

description: Implement membership + roles (admin/submitter/approver); enforce in API and UI.
steps: Dependencies: require workspace membership and role checks.

description: Workspace-level setting for data language used by mapper/translation output.
Per-user UI language setting; default from workspace.
Frontend uses /auth/me (or /whoami) to render role + workspace context.
steps: Add API call on app boot.

description: Ensure runtime code references workspace only (no tenant/project/org wording).
steps: Search frontend/backend for tenant/org/project runtime strings.
Replace headers and payload keys (keep compat only where needed).

description: Admin UI to list/create/edit/delete entity types (workspace-scoped).
Admin defines custom properties (fields) per entity type (Address, Lat, Long, Country Code, etc).
steps: Design schema: entity_type_fields (key, label, type, required, order, options).

feature: Entity Type fields: validation + field types
description: Support types (text/number/date/select) + required + basic validation.
Field ordering and optional UI grouping for nice forms.
Workspace-scoped CRUD for entity_type_fields.
steps: Return fields with entity type payload.

description: Ensure field keys are canonical and stable (e.g. property_id, address1).
steps: Add unique constraint per (workspace, entity_type, key).

description: Seed example fields for Property entity type.
Lock entity type schema editing to admins.
List/create/edit entities for an entity type; support archive.

feature: Entities: dynamic form from entity type fields
description: Render per-entity custom field inputs based on entity_type_fields.
Backend storage for per-entity field values (validated against schema).
Assignments are per entity (submitter/approver) with active flag.
steps: Create entity_assignments table: entity_id, user_id, role, active.

description: Admin can assign submitters/approvers to each entity.
steps: Build assignment editor UI (user picker + role).

description: Submitter only sees entities assigned to them (unless admin).

feature: Approver dashboard: assigned entities + pending submissions
description: Approver sees assigned entities and submissions needing review.
Admin can import entities via CSV.
steps: Define CSV format (name, external_id, plus field keys).

description: Support external_id and show clearly in UI.
steps: Expose in UI forms and lists.

description: Admin defines report types/templates and required fields (optionally per provider).
steps: Define models: report_types, report_fields (and providers if needed).

description: Define schedules per report type (monthly/quarterly) and generate submission periods.
Choose entity → report type → period → upload → map → review → submit.
Upload any data type; store raw and parsed artifacts for mapping.
steps: Parse job scaffolding (sync for now, async later).

description: Heuristics to pick sheet with core data (density/header-likeness).
Support mapping selectors: cell/column/range (CSV/XLSX/TXT) and JSON key paths.
Persist mappings per (workspace, report_type, entity_type, provider). Entity values override file values. Detect date formats/language and notify approvers on submit.
steps: Implement mapping persistence tables and API.
Implement priority: entity field value > static override > file-derived.
Add confidence scoring + date format detection + language detection.
On submission submitted: create notifications for approvers + email via MailHog.

description: Formalize mapping pipeline: heuristics → embeddings → mini-LLM (only if low confidence).
steps: Define a common internal candidate format for mappings (selectors + provenance).
Implement confidence thresholds (e.g. auto-apply >=0.85; ask user 0.5–0.85; LLM assist <0.5).
Return structured warnings + ‘needs user input’ reasons.

description: Add an embeddings layer for multilingual header/field matching without relying on OpenAI.
steps: Implement embedding + cosine similarity to score header↔field matches.
Cache embeddings per (workspace, report_type, entity_type, provider) and per upload.

feature: Smart mapper: local mini LLM (Docker pull)
description: Add a small local model (Ollama/llama.cpp) to resolve ambiguous mappings and generate JSON mapping proposals.
steps: Pick runtime: Ollama container (simplest) or llama.cpp server.
Define strict JSON output schema + validate.
Call local model only when confidence is low or ambiguity detected.

feature: Smart mapper: sheet/table detection + selection UX
description: Improve table detection (Excel tabs, table ranges) and expose overrides in UI.
steps: Implement sheet scoring and table region detection (header row + range).
Expose detected sheet/range with preview and allow user override.
Persist user-confirmed choices to improve future mappings.

description: Make OpenAI optional by introducing a mapper-provider interface (local-first; OpenAI as fallback if enabled).
steps: Refactor current OpenAI call behind an interface.
Add config flags: MAPPER_PROVIDER=local|openai; LOCAL_LLM_URL; EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=local.
Update docs + remove requirement for OPENAI_API_KEY when local mode is used.
